result.description: Private and public capital markets data platform (companies, deals, investors, funds) with a contract-only Direct Data API and a Premium MCP connector.
result.auth_detail: Per third-party docs: API key or token sent as `Authorization: PB-Token {key}`, issued by PitchBook's Direct Data team under contract. PitchBook's official pages were not fetchable (403), so this is unconfirmed first-party. The MCP connector uses a browser sign-in.
result.access_detail: The API is sold as a separate product on a standalone contract. Credentials are provisioned by the Direct Data team. The endpoint reference sits behind platform login, and rate limits and pricing are not published. A developer sandbox may be arranged only through the Direct Data team.
result.api_notes: REST at api.pitchbook.com (Direct Data, credit-based). Likely covers companies, deals, investors and funds, but the endpoint reference is private. Breadth could not be verified from public docs, so this is a best estimate.
result.blocker: The API needs a standalone PitchBook contract and credits. Docs are private and there is no self-serve signup or public sandbox. The official MCP connector needs a PitchBook Premium subscription.

evidence.quote: Our API is a separate offering from the PitchBook Platform that requires a standalone contract agreement.
Documentation is private. The endpoint reference and request shapes sit behind platform login, so evaluation requires a contract.
PitchBook uses an API key sent as Authorization: PB-Token {key}, not a bearer token.
PitchBook Premium Connector, built on MCP server technology
PitchBook provisions access with an API key or authentication token and does not publish fixed API prices or a complete public request example.
